items.name: Archbishop Eric R. Figueroa Sr.
items.bio: A Brooklyn native holding doctorates in Divinity and Theology, Archbishop Figueroa founded New Life Tabernacle in 1983 and was consecrated Bishop in 1998. He is Metropolitan Archbishop and Presiding Prelate of New Life Covenant Fellowship, founded the Family Life Development Center, and recorded *He’s a Rock* with the Mass Choir. His wife, Doreen, has served beside him from the beginning.

items.name: Pastor Eric Figueroa Jr.
items.bio: Pastor Figueroa Jr. grew up at New Life Tabernacle and serves alongside his father, Archbishop Figueroa.

items.name: Pastor Timiney Figueroa
items.bio: Pastor Timiney Figueroa serves on the pastoral team at New Life Tabernacle.
